newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA PLANS TO SELL 40-45 PCT OF SOMAT CARRIER.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA PLANS TO SELL 40-45 PCT OF SOMAT CARRIER.

text.p: Bulgaria plans to offer for sale 40-45 percent of its biggest road transport carrier SOMAT, officials said on Monday.
"The ministry has submitted a proposal to the Privatisation Agency to open a sell-off procedure for up to 45 percent of SOMAT shares," Transport minister Wilhelm Kraus told reporters.
The stake will be probabaly offered to private investors through a tender, Kraus added.

"The actual stake to be offered could be around 40 percent because SOMAT employes now hold some 3.5 percent and 1.5 percent have been set aside to meet restitution claims," a SOMAT official told Reuters.
Fifty five percent of the company are owned by Germany's Willi Betz Internationale Spedition, which bought the stake for $55 million in August 1994.
